title: luzula campestris subsp. pallescens
intro: Luzula campestris subsp. pallescens, commonly known as pale woodrush, is a plant species belonging to the family Juncaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of pale woodrush include its ability to modulate the immune system and exert antioxidant effects, making it a promising candidate for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Luzula campestris subsp. pallescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
